description: Website technologies only, for 1-3 sites. Use this when you need to know what a website is built with, for lead qualification by technology or competitor research. Fetches each homepage once; no DNS, email or registration data (use email_security or domain_registration). Input: domains (1-3 domains or URLs). Returns results[] with, per site: reachable, blocked, finalUrl, statusCode, title, description, language; technologies[] (CMS, e-commerce platform, frameworks, analytics, tag managers, CDN, chat and more, each with category and the evidence it was detected from); securityHeaders the homepage sends; errors, analyzedAt and cached. Sites that block bots return blocked=true. Limits: each domain counts as one lookup; answers cached for 1 hour per domain; 25 free domains a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored, no email is sent.

domains.description: 1-3 domains, website URLs or email addresses (the domain part is used)
